title: No Absorption Hearts
description: A Minecraft resource pack that removes absorption hearts while preserving the look and functionality of the hearts (to an extent).
body:
This resource pack is for Hypixel Skyblock players who don't like health overlays from mods and prefer the vanilla hearts (like me) and generally for players who constantly have the absorption effect but have no use seeing it. This would be better done as a mod but currently this is the extent of my abilities. 

This resource pack removes the container (empty heart) texture to work, which means that it'll be harder to tell how many hearts you're missing.

There is an instance in which part of the absorption hearts reappear: when the player has the withered effect applied. This cannot be fixed with a resource pack.

Note: I highly recommend using the mod [Devonian](https://modrinth.com/mod/devonian) to hide the absorption hearts if you wish to keep the full functionality of the hearts. You can do this by going to the "Vanilla Tweaks" Section and enabling "Accurate Absorption" as well as setting "Max Absorption Hearts" to 0. There could be other mods out there that do this but this one is the only one i've found so far.
